credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: O'Keeffe, wearing a black suit, leans forward in a lawn chair, petting her chow on the portal at Ghost Ranch. Behind her are two smiling young men, one in a beard and plaid shirt, the other one in a hooded sweatshirt and glasses. Visible in the background is a shelf with antlers and skulls.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe with Chow and Friends at Ghost Ranch
